dedupe_keys.name: beep battery evaluation and early prediction

description: BEEP is a Python toolset supporting battery evaluation and early prediction of cycle life, associated with the Toyota Research Institute and the d3batt research programme. It reads battery-cycler exports and structures them for subsequent analysis. The README lists Arbin, Novonix, MACCOR, BioLogic, Neware and Battery Archive formats and demonstrates loading a MACCOR file and reading its structured summary. Coverage is global at cell-test level; chemistry, cycle duration and measurement resolution depend on the input experiment. Public source, pip installation and linked documentation are free under Apache-2.0. A limitation is that support for named cyclers does not establish compatibility with every firmware or export variant. Structured summaries also do not themselves validate a lifetime model for a deployed storage asset. BEEP can prepare calibration data for battery degradation assumptions used in energy-system simulations, complementary to PyPSA (model-pypsa). The SoftwareX 2020 article describes the implementation. This review did not retrieve cycler data, train a predictor or install the package.
